# InviteStory — Handcrafted Digital Wedding Invitations for Indian Couples

> InviteStory (https://invitestory.in) builds single-event, single-link interactive web wedding invitations designed specifically for Indian weddings. Couples select from 20 culturally-curated templates (Royal Palace, South Indian, Nikah, Walima, Hindu Muhurtham, Ghibli Animation, Beach, Garden), send their event details over WhatsApp, and receive a live custom web invite link within 24 hours.

## Core Principles & Ethos
- **One Day, One Wedding Event:** Focuses strictly on the main wedding event. Sub-moments (Baraat, Pheras, Jaimala, Nikah ceremony) fit inside the single-day timeline to eliminate multi-day schedule clutter.
- **No RSVP Friction:** Indian wedding guests are invited personally or via phone/WhatsApp. InviteStory removes annoying RSVP forms or WhatsApp confirmation buttons—the invite link acts as an elegant announcement.
- **Built-in Google Calendar & Maps:** Every template features one-click Google Calendar / .ics event addition and interactive venue directions via Google Maps.
- **Instant WhatsApp Sharing:** Optimised mobile performance (under 3-5 MB payload) with rich OpenGraph visual cards when shared in WhatsApp chats.

## Pricing Tiers
- **Classic Tier (₹999):** Includes Sage Parchment, Marigold Bhavan, Kalyana Mandapam. Standard 24-hour turnaround with couple names, muhurtham, venue maps, calendar integration.
- **Signature Tier (₹1,999):** Includes Royal Reception, Noor-e-Zahra, Kerala Sands, Shubha Vivaham, Toran Telugu, Tamil Thirumana, Emerald Nikah, Meadow Nikah, Midnight Stargaze, Ghibli Portrait, Lake Pichola Royal. Includes custom domain options, photo swap, and 24-hour delivery.
- **Royale Tier (₹2,999):** Includes Rajwada Royale, Rajmahal Palace, Ghibli Selfie, Grand Line Voyage. Includes priority WhatsApp support, custom image hand-edits, and premium opening door / shutter animations.
